data.body: AC amendment [important]: Clarify JQL retry semantics — probe-level retry is for 'search returned 0 results' (Jira label indexing eventual consistency), NOT for subprocess failure (which _run_acli's existing 3x retry handles). Specify total wall-clock budget (e.g. 3 attempts × 2s backoff). Add test that retry fires on empty result but not on subprocess error.
